Beab.description: Hi there, this is Beab. I am currently in the development of a small twincities based internet radio station. The station is called Souvenir or Souvenir FM or Souvenir Radio. The goal of this station is to give a platform to the countless number of djs, artists and entertainers in the twincities. I think that having a small internet radio station thats based in the twin cities will help strengthen our muscial communities more. This is a test. I will be slowly rolling out features and update the ui. Cheers.
